title: In vitro and in silico analysis of 'Taikong blue' lavender essential oil in LPS-induced HaCaT cells and RAW264.7 murine macrophages.
authors: Wei, Mengya; Liu, Fei; Raka, Rifat Nowshin; Xiang, Jie; Xiao, Junsong; Han, Tingting; Guo, Fengjiao; Yang, Suzhen; Wu, Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薰衣草精油的抗炎抗氧化作用，仅含分子对接预测配体，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: 'Taikong blue' lavender, a space-bred cultivar of Lavandula angustifolia, is one of the main lavender essential oil production crops in Xinjiang Province, China. Several cases of local usage indicated that 'Taikong blue' lavender essential oil (TLEO) had excellent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties for skin problems. However, to date, substantial data on these functions are lacking. In this study, we aimed to investigate the composition and bioactivities of TLEO and the potential underlying mechanisms through LPS-induced inflammatory models of HaCaT and RAW264.7 cells. METHODS: The composition of TLEO was determined by GC‒MS. To study the anti-inflammatory and antioxidative properties of TLEO, we induced HaCaT and RAW264.7 cells by LPS. TLEO (0.001%-0.1%, v/v) was used to treat inflamed cells with dexamethasone (DEX, 10 mug/mL) as the standard drug. A variety of tests were carried out, including biochemical assays, ELISA, RT‒PCR, and western blotting. Docking of components was performed to predict potential ligands. RESULTS: The GC‒MS analysis revealed that 53 compounds (> 0.01%) represented 99.76% of the TLEO, and the majority of them were esters. TLEO not only reduced the levels of oxidative stress indicators (NO, ROS, MDA, and iNOS at the mRNA and protein levels) but also protected the SOD and CAT activities. According to the RT‒PCR, ELISA, and Western blot results, TLEO decreased inflammation by inhibiting the expression of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and key proteins (IkappaBalpha, NF-small ka, CyrillicB p65, p50, JNK, and p38 MAPK) in MAPK-NF-small ka, CyrillicB signaling. Molecular docking results showed that all of the components (> 1% in TLEO) were potent candidate ligands for further research. CONCLUSION: The theoretical evidence for TLEO in this study supported its use in skin care as a functional ingredient for cosmetics and pharmaceutics.
abstract_zh: 背景：“太空蓝”薰衣草（Lavandula angustifolia）是一种经太空育种获得的品种，是中国新疆省主要的薰衣草精油生产作物之一。当地使用案例表明，“太空蓝”薰衣草精油（TLEO）对皮肤问题具有优异的抗炎和抗氧化特性。然而，迄今为止，关于这些功能的实质性数据仍然缺乏。本研究旨在通过LPS诱导的HaCaT和RAW264.7细胞炎症模型，探讨TLEO的组成、生物活性及其潜在作用机制。方法：采用GC-MS测定TLEO的组成。为研究TLEO的抗炎和抗氧化特性，我们使用LPS诱导HaCaT和RAW264.7细胞。以地塞米松（DEX，10 μg/mL）作为标准药物，用TLEO（0.001%-0.1%，v/v）处理炎症细胞。进行了多种测试，包括生化检测、ELISA、RT-PCR和Western blotting。对组分进行分子对接以预测潜在配体。结果：GC-MS分析显示，53种化合物（>0.01%）占TLEO的99.76%，其中大部分为酯类。TLEO不仅降低了氧化应激指标的水平（NO、ROS、MDA以及iNOS在mRNA和蛋白水平），还保护了SOD和CAT的活性。根据RT-PCR、ELISA和Western blot结果，TLEO通过抑制TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6以及MAPK-NF-κB信号通路中的关键蛋白（IκBα、NF-κB p65、p50、JNK和p38 MAPK）的表达来减轻炎症。分子对接结果显示，TLEO中所有组分（>1%）都是进一步研究的有力候选配体。结论：本研究中TLEO的理论证据支持其作为化妆品和药品的功能性成分用于皮肤护理。
